name: Tasker Scene and Task XML (Generated Projects)
description: Knowledge: how to generate Tasker project XML (scenes, tasks, profiles) from code and import it on a rooted phone; action codes, element shapes and the gotchas found building the Claude Panel.
content:
# Generating Tasker XML

Tasker 6.x imports .prj.xml / .tsk.xml / .prf.xml (not .scn.xml) through its own importer:
`am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -t text/xml -d file:///sdcard/Download/X.prj.xml -n net.dinglisch.android.taskerm/com.joaomgcd.taskerm.datashare.import.ActivityImportTaskerDataFromXml`
The user taps YES (and YES to enable). The importer re-reads the file after the first YES, so delete it only after Tasker's files/autobackup.xml mtime changes. The IntentHandler file:// handler only copies the file; it does not import.

## Action codes (args by sr name)
- 129 JavaScriptlet: arg0 code, arg1 libraries, arg2 auto-exit, arg3 timeout (s)
- 30 Wait: arg0 ms, arg1 s, arg2 min, arg3 h, arg4 days
- 135 Goto: ConditionList (op 2 = matches) + Int arg0 0 (action number), arg1 target action #, arg2 label
- 360 Input Dialog: arg1 title, arg2 text, arg3 default, arg4 timeout; result in %input
- 378 List Dialog: Bundle arg0, arg1 1 (single choice), arg2 title, arg3 items (comma separated or %array), arg6 OK label, arg7 cancel label, arg9 timeout, arg10-12 0; result in %ld_selected
- 159 Profile Status: arg0 profile name, arg1 Int (0 off, 1 on)
- 47 Show Scene, 49 Destroy Scene, 51 Element Text
- Assistance Request event (long-press power / assist gesture): Event code 201

## Scene elements
- TextElement: arg2 size, arg4 colour, arg7 alignment, arg8 long-text
- ButtonElement: clickTask = task id, arg1 label

## Gotchas
- Only one task instance runs at a time per name, and one long JavaScriptlet loop starves button tasks: poll with JS (one cycle) + Wait + Goto instead of a while loop in JS.
- A scene shown as a blocking overlay cancels dialogs: hide the scene before Input/List Dialog, show it again after.
- shell() in a JavaScriptlet drops the CRs of the output: parse HTTP replies with \r?\n\r?\n.
- XMLHttpRequest with a custom header (e.g. a token) triggers a CORS preflight against a local server: use shell() + nc with the body in a file instead.
- KEYCODE_ASSIST presses under ~150 ms are dropped; simulate the gesture with `input keyevent --duration 900 KEYCODE_POWER`.
- Exported XML has attributes without spaces between them; fix that with a regex before parsing it with a strict XML parser.
- Tasker project variables are stored in plain text in the backup: never put API keys there.
